entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: What do you think, Inmate? Surprised?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: This is a failsafe to ensure you do not[n]neglect your rehabilitation. It's intended[n]to push you into performing executions.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: It's a warning system that tells you when[n]you've been slacking off on your duties!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: When you hear this sound, the first[n]things on your mind should be this[n]place and executions!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You must become stronger for the sake[n]of your rehabilitation.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Executions will be much more severe[n]when the alarm is sounding!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: The result of this is that any fused[n]Personas will be further strengthened!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However, the more executions that you[n]perform during the alarm, the higher[n]the chance of an accident occurring.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: With that in mind, you must prepare[n]more than usual while performing[n]executions in the midst of an alarm.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: The alarm will sound after you've[n]endured numerous repeated battles!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Make certain you come here as soon[n]as you hear it! Got that!?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Good! You'd better make excellent use[n]of the alarm!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: What was that, you cheeky bastard!?[n]You'll return here at once, without[n]a second thought!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Well then, continue to devote yourself[n]to your rehabilitation.
